title: Consequences Of Helping A Rapist Escape
description:
On April 23rd, 2023, officers were dispatched in regards to a case of sexual assault. While searching for the abuser, officers called his girlfriend but they suspected that she was hiding something. Soon, one of the officer’s spotted the suspect escaping from the back window. Meanwhile, officer’s got hold of his girlfriend as well. The male was charged with 2nd degree domestic violence and rape while the female was charged with resisting arrest and obstructing investigation.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
